item.title: Heart Attack Warning Signs: What to Look For and What to Do
item.description: Learn the common and less obvious signs of a heart attack in men and women, why every minute counts, and exactly what to do while help is on the way.

item.title: Blood Pressure Numbers Explained: Normal, Elevated and High
item.description: What your systolic and diastolic numbers mean, the adult blood-pressure categories, how to measure accurately at home, and proven ways to lower high blood pressure.

item.title: Cholesterol Explained: LDL, HDL, Triglycerides and What Your Results Mean
item.description: A clear guide to cholesterol tests — LDL, HDL, non-HDL and triglycerides — why they matter for heart disease, and how to improve your numbers.

item.title: The Heart-Healthy Diet: A Practical Guide to Eating for Your Heart
item.description: What to eat more of, what to limit, and simple swaps based on DASH and Mediterranean-style eating — with ideas that work across cuisines.

item.title: Exercise for Heart Health: How Much, What Kind and How to Start Safely
item.description: The weekly activity targets for adults, the best types of exercise for your heart, how to use heart-rate zones, and safe ways to start.

item.title: Atrial Fibrillation (AFib): Symptoms, Stroke Risk and Treatment Options
item.description: Understand atrial fibrillation — what it is, common symptoms, why it raises stroke risk, how it's diagnosed and the main treatment options.

item.title: Heart Failure: What It Means and How to Live Well With It
item.description: Heart failure doesn't mean the heart has stopped. Learn the symptoms, types, treatments and daily self-care habits that help people with heart failure feel better.

item.title: Women's Heart Health: Risks, Symptoms and What Every Woman Should Know
item.description: Heart disease is a leading cause of death for women. Learn the symptoms that are more common in women and the risks linked to pregnancy and menopause.

item.title: Why South Asians Face Higher Heart Disease Risk — and What to Do About It
item.description: People of South Asian origin tend to develop heart disease earlier. Learn the reasons, the screening that matters, and practical prevention steps.

item.title: Stress, Sleep and Your Heart: The Hidden Connection
item.description: How chronic stress and poor sleep affect blood pressure and heart health, plus practical, evidence-based techniques to sleep better and stress less.

item.title: Hands-Only CPR: A Simple Guide That Can Save a Life
item.description: Learn how to recognise cardiac arrest and perform Hands-Only CPR in two steps, how to use an AED, and why bystander action doubles survival chances.

item.title: Heart Tests Explained: ECG, Echo, Stress Test, CT and Angiography
item.description: A plain-language guide to common heart tests — what they show, how they're done, how to prepare, and questions to ask your doctor.

item.title: Planning a Heart Procedure: Second Opinions, Hospitals and Costs
item.description: Facing angioplasty, bypass surgery, valve replacement or a pacemaker? How to get a second opinion, compare hospitals, understand costs and prepare for recovery.
